about: The one place the content engine's settings live (Justin, 24 November 2026). The radar code, START HERE, the Metricool handoff and the skills read this file. Change a setting here, not in code. config/README.md says what each part does and where it takes effect. GitHub's post register stays the only place a GDC number is claimed.

pause.note: Set all to true to stop every stage after research (nothing written, handed off or scheduled). Set scheduling to true to keep producing packs but stop ChatGPT scheduling them.

lines: Don't make a ban the only respectable parenting choice.
Give parents the information and tools to decide.

voice.familyAccount: we, Justin and Natalia together, Natalia's ear as the test (family-social); Justin speaks as I only on LinkedIn, Substack and what he signs. Justin, 24 November 2026: yes
